args.purpose: List scores and comments of reviews created in September 2018
args.sql:
SELECT review_score, review_comment_message
FROM order_reviews
WHERE review_creation_date >= '2018-09-01' AND review_creation_date < '2018-10-01'
ORDER BY review_creation_date;
